content.title: Suspended Accident | Active Sampling While the World Stays Frozen
content.summary: Freeze an unexpected accident at maximum chaos while allowing only one subject to keep moving through the suspended evidence, deliberately remove several separated objects, and exit. Wider views must prove that the rest of the scene remains frozen; the anomaly is defined by the subject's exclusive freedom of action.

quick_start.input_format: Daily multi-subject scene + single accident peak hover + only movable subject + two active sampling actions + departure while the remaining scene stays suspended
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original orbital seed library, two technicians are inspecting the sealed seed tank. A brass maintenance beetle is parked on the ground, and the transparent cooling tube is under pressure; the beetle passes under three strings of fixed liquid beads, scanning the technicians, floating tanks and amber diagnostic pieces in sequence without touching them; the beetle carries two samples through the hatch. The wide angle before the door is closed proves that the entire accident scene is still hovering and eventually no longer flows.
required_anchors: Establish an ordinary routine and the routes of at least two participants before the accident.
Use one accident to distribute several independently readable objects across depth.
Have the mobile subject selectively remove at least two separated objects without releasing the rest.
End with the subject leaving while a wider view still proves the accident remains suspended.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Freeze an unexpected accident at maximum chaos while allowing only one subject to keep moving through the suspended evidence, deliberately remove several separated objects, and exit. Wider views must prove that the rest of the scene remains frozen; the anomaly is defined by the subject's exclusive freedom of action.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish an ordinary shared routine, interrupt it with one physical accident that distributes several readable objects, and suspend the accident at maximum disorder. Let exactly one subject retain normal agency, deliberately sample at least two separated pieces of the frozen event, then leave while the wider tableau remains visibly locked. The persistent world state, not a later restart, is the payoff.

invariants.rule: Establish an ordinary routine and the routes of at least two participants before the accident.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on suspended debris turns the event into unexplained decoration.

invariants.rule: Use one accident to distribute several independently readable objects across depth.
invariants.ablation_failure: One floating prop cannot prove a shared physical state.

invariants.rule: At peak disorder, keep all participants and objects fixed except one clearly mobile subject.
invariants.purpose: Gives the anomaly an unambiguous agency rule.
invariants.ablation_failure: If several people move, the freeze becomes an editing ambiguity.

invariants.rule: Have the mobile subject selectively remove at least two separated objects without releasing the rest.
invariants.purpose: Proves deliberate interaction inside the fixed state.
invariants.ablation_failure: A passive walk-through never tests the suspension.

invariants.rule: End with the subject leaving while a wider view still proves the accident remains suspended.
invariants.purpose: Turns persistence into the final consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: A global restart would replace the mechanism with a generic time-freeze release.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source black-haired woman and pink-uniform waitress
red vinyl booths and checkerboard floor
breakfast tray, eggs, bacon, toast and coffee spill
the source food-sampling gag and elevator exit

instantiations.concept: In an original orbital seed bank, a coolant line bursts and freezes technicians, seed canisters and liquid spheres in midair. One maintenance beetle remains mobile, plucks two diagnostic wafers from different frozen streams, then crosses an iris hatch while the bay stays locked.

instantiations.concept: In stop-motion clay theatre, a print-shop rack collapses and suspends rollers, paper strips, ink drops and three puppets. One wooden apprentice collects a blue swatch and a brass type block from separate positions, then exits through the drying cabinet while the collapse remains fixed.
